title: Retry Ladder and Dead-Letter Queue
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Retry Ladder and Dead-Letter Queue.
learning_objectives: Explain retry ladder and dead-letter queue using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for retry ladder and dead-letter queue
Assess failure and operational limits of retry ladder and dead-letter queue
concepts_covered: A retry queue delays a message before routing it back; a dead-letter queue holds exhausted or terminal failures.
Retry TTL grows as base × 4^(N-1); x-retry-count and max_retries govern exhaustion.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
